item.title: Unique ways to celebrate Valentine’s Day 2026 beyond dinner dates and roses
item.description: Valentine’s Day 2026 is inspiring couples to rethink romance with unique celebration ideas, meaningful experiences, and creative moments beyond traditional plans. Explore fresh ways to make the day special and start planning something unforgettable today.

item.title: ‘This is dignity, not charity’: Sonu Sood offers work to Rajpal Yadav after actor’s jail surrender
item.description: The film industry has rallied behind Rajpal Yadav after his surrender at Tihar Jail, with Sonu Sood leading the support. Calling dignity more important than charity, Sonu urged Bollywood to stand by Rajpal during his toughest phase. Read what Sonu said, the legal background, and what happens next.

item.title: Sarvam AI beats Google Gemini and ChatGPT in key Indian language AI benchmarks
item.description: Sarvam AI, a Bengaluru-based startup, has outperformed Google Gemini and OpenAI’s ChatGPT in key benchmarks focused on Indian languages, documents, and speech systems. Instead of building a general chatbot, the company trains smaller, India-first models using local data, scripts, and real-world workflows.

item.title: GHMC elected body’s term ends today; to be under special officer’s rule
item.description: The civic body will be administered by a special officer of secretary rank and state govt is expected to appoint an officer soon.

item.description: Tata Motors and Stellantis have marked 20 years of their Indian joint venture with a new MoU. The partnership has produced over 1.37 million vehicles and will now explore fresh collaboration plans.

item.title: From corruption to price rise: Key issues dominating Bangladesh’s Feb 12 polls
item.description: With over 128 million voters eligible to vote in Bangladesh this year, it will be a test of democracy in India’s neighbouring country. The country witnessed massive protests across Bangladesh over the last few years, which led to the present situation in the country.
